statistical_consequence.failure_mode: the same Lean statement can be faithful for one problem and unfaithful for another, so a global statement cluster is not a label-homogeneous prevalence unit
statistical_consequence.frame_bias: cross-problem collapse gives discarded problem-conditioned candidates zero frame inclusion probability and makes stratum population sizes and inclusion propensities target the wrong population
statistical_consequence.coverage_risk: a single global cluster can satisfy multiple source-proxy coverage cells despite yielding only one representative problem in the frame
statistical_consequence.estimand_followup: the plan must state whether prevalence targets unique candidate-problem units or generator-call outputs; representative-family strata support the former only and must not be presented as per-generator call prevalence without a separate design
